stance_basis: approved Elements I-III but required environmental impact process completion; restricted Element IV to initial engineering only
summary: The U.S. Secretary of Transportation approved proceeding with preliminary engineering on Elements I, II, and III of the Regional Transit Development Program in December 1976, but conditioned this approval on completion of the environmental impact process. For Element IV (Regional Core Rapid Transit), the Secretary stipulated only 'initial' engineering on both rail and all-bus alternatives, consistent with UMTA's incremental approach policy for rail transit development.
complaint_summary: The U.S. Secretary of Transportation approved preliminary engineering on Elements I, II, and III subject to completion of the environmental impact process, while limiting Element IV to initial engineering only on both rail and all-bus alternatives within the Wilshire-La Brea corridor.
summary_quote: In December 1976 by letter addressed to the SCRTD and the Mayor of the City of Los Angeles, the U.S. Secretary of Transportation approved proceeding with preliminary engineering on Elements I, II and III, subject to the proviso that they complete the environmental impact process.
